name: night
purpose: Detect problems in emissive maps, lit signs, storefront lettering, fuel stations, billboards and night-only materials.
_time_semantics: Observed in BeamNG 0.39.4 West Coast USA: time 0.5 = midnight (street lights on). See day.json.
_note: With cloudCover 0 the night is moonlit: non-emissive signs stay readable (with default clouds they were black silhouettes). Street lights and lit storefronts are on - use NIGHT mainly for families with emissive maps.
_environment: windSpeed 0 (default 0.1) stops cloud drift inside one load; cloudCover 0 (default 1) removes clouds, which are laid out differently on every level load and shift auto-exposure. Applied with core_environment.setState via run_lua.
